_comment: Images matching a skip glob are served as their pristine original (no AVIF/WebP, no recompression, no <picture> wrapping). Use for FLAT brand graphics — logos, wordmarks, solid-color hero art — where lossy AVIF causes visible banding/color shift. Do NOT skip photographs; they compress well and hide artifacts. 'keep' globs are exceptions carved back out of a broad skip. Paths are repo-root-relative, forward slashes.
